title.en: Hormuz crisis on a crude cargo: reprice, then pause
title.zh: 霍尔木兹危机（原油货）：先降价，后暂停

description.en: A war-risk escalation near the Strait of Hormuz hits a crude cargo: as war risk rises the agent lowers the issue price (a higher annual rate for the added risk), then pauses the pool when the strait closes. It stays paused until risk clears. Simulated.
description.zh: 霍尔木兹海峡附近战争风险升级，冲击一批原油货：风险上升时 Agent 先下调发行价（为新增风险支付更高的年化利率），海峡封闭后暂停资金池，风险解除前保持暂停。全程为模拟。

label.zh: 霍尔木兹附近出现军事活动

events.description: Naval activity reported near the Strait of Hormuz
Strait of Hormuz declared closed to commercial shipping
